families.title: Pinned build and authority foundation
families.mechanism: artifact pinning, supported-build selection, and authority modeling
families.invariant: all later claims use one authorized, reproducible source and runtime identity

families.title: External ingress and authority transitions
families.boundary: untrusted input to privileged parser, handler, or principal
families.invariant: untrusted input must not acquire authority absent the required gate

families.title: Execution sink backtracing
families.boundary: privileged execution or native effect back to attacker-controlled data
families.mechanism: backward control-flow, data-flow, guard, and capability analysis
families.invariant: execution sinks must be dominated by complete authorization and type checks

families.title: Memory ownership and lifetime corruption
families.boundary: allocation, ownership, lifetime, and concurrent object reuse
families.mechanism: integer-domain, use-after-free, stale-view, race, and type-confusion analysis
families.invariant: live typed references must describe valid storage with exclusive expected ownership

families.title: Producer-consumer representation mismatch
families.boundary: serialized, normalized, or framed data crossing between producers and consumers
families.mechanism: length, signedness, duplicate-field, encoding, framing, and object-shape differentials
families.invariant: all producers and consumers must agree on the domain and identity of one value

families.title: Capability and code-loading confusion
families.boundary: data authority becoming function, module, path, manifest, or callback authority
families.mechanism: identity, provenance, namespace, containment, and manifest validation
families.invariant: attacker-controlled data must not select or manufacture executable authority

families.title: Remote coordinate acquisition
families.boundary: private build or runtime coordinates becoming remotely obtainable
families.mechanism: public-protocol disclosure, deterministic derivation, bounded oracle, and leak analysis
families.invariant: an exploit may depend only on coordinates an attacker can actually obtain

families.title: Stock deployment reachability
families.boundary: diagnostic primitive crossing into an unmodified supported deployment
families.mechanism: configuration, topology, platform, resource, and request-sequence validation
families.invariant: the claimed chain must survive without test-only hooks or vulnerable consumer code

families.title: JIT optimization invariant failure
families.boundary: language semantics crossing speculative optimization and generated machine code
families.mechanism: feedback, representation, lowering, deoptimization, and alias invariant analysis
families.invariant: optimized code must preserve language and heap semantics for every accepted input

families.title: WebAssembly validation and compiler mismatch
families.boundary: validated Wasm modules crossing decoder, compiler, and runtime tiers
families.mechanism: type, bounds, canonicalization, tiering, and module-lifecycle differentials
families.invariant: compiled behavior must remain within the capabilities established by validation

families.title: V8 sandbox capability escape
families.boundary: sandboxed heap references crossing into trusted process memory or control flow
families.mechanism: external-pointer, trusted-pointer, code-pointer, handle, and table validation
families.invariant: sandbox-controlled indices and objects must not address unsandboxed capabilities

families.title: Structure-aware state-space generation
families.boundary: valid high-level programs reaching rare engine state transitions
families.mechanism: grammar, AST, stateful mutation, differential execution, and coverage feedback
families.invariant: semantically related executions must not expose memory-unsafe divergence

families.title: Browser-process integration and renderer reachability
families.boundary: web content crossing renderer, engine, sandbox, and browser integration layers
families.mechanism: owned-page reachability, process-boundary validation, and sandbox-enabled replay
families.invariant: engine primitives must not cross the browser security boundary unexpectedly

families.title: Pinned dependency and integration-boundary analysis
families.boundary: target-owned input and state crossing into exact bundled, runtime, native, build, or transitive dependency code
families.mechanism: lockfile provenance, cross-library data flow, parser and lifetime assumptions, callback authority, native boundaries, and primitive composition
families.invariant: a target must preserve its security guarantees across every dependency boundary exercised by the supported build

families.title: Executable static-analysis lead generation
families.boundary: pinned source crossing from machine analysis into the durable research queue
families.mechanism: single-revision syntax census, CPG queries, structural entrypoint mapping, constraint solving, and provenance-bound task ingestion
families.invariant: static hypotheses must retain their tool provenance and receive manual plus runtime validation before promotion

families.title: Blocked-link alternative route analysis
families.boundary: a falsified chain link and adjacent routes to the same security boundary
families.mechanism: guard analysis, cheapest discriminators, sibling representations, and alternate state transitions
families.invariant: one blocked mechanism does not imply that every route to the target boundary is closed

families.title: Cross-family exploit composition
families.boundary: independent primitives composing into a complete Critical or RCE chain
families.mechanism: missing-link graphs, carrier compatibility, and end-to-end constraint solving
families.invariant: every chain link must have compatible attacker control and supported deployment state

families.title: Controls and independent replay
families.boundary: research claim crossing into reportable evidence
families.mechanism: positive and negative controls, clean replay, adversarial review, and synthesis
families.invariant: only independently reproducible stock-build effects with an exhaustive contradiction-free source-to-sink path proof may be promoted
